## Frequently asked questions

Squarespace offers both monthly and annual subscriptions. We make it simple to start—and stop—your plan at any time.

  

We also offer discounts when you choose an annual plan instead of paying monthly. Annual subscriptions also include one year of free domain registration for new websites.

Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and if you cancel, your service will continue through the period you've already paid for.

Squarespace doesn't offer a free plan, but every site starts with a free trial—no credit card required.

Every Squarespace website starts with a 14-day free trial. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time during or after your trial.

Yes. If you purchase an annual plan, you'll receive a free custom domain for one year. You can also connect a domain you already own or buy a new domain through Squarespace with any subscription.

Yes. All Squarespace plans include our fully-managed cloud hosting, ensuring your website remains available at all times.

Squarespace occasionally runs promotions, and we always share them directly through our website or emails. For the best price long-term, our annual plans offer built-in savings compared to monthly billing. Find our current offers, discounts, and student pricing here.

Yes, eligible students can get a discount through our student program. Learn more here.

All paid Squarespace plans let you sell products or services, but specific ecommerce features vary by plan. Compare plans above to see which best supports your business.

With Squarespace Payments as your payment solution, you can centralize your finances in one easy-to-use dashboard while accepting Klarna, Afterpay, Apple Pay, ACH, and all major credit cards. Squarespace Payments is currently available in the United States, United Kingdom, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, and Spain.

Squarespace Payments transaction fees and rates vary per subscription plan. Please see above in the Full Feature Comparison for details.

We accept AMEX, Visa, Mastercard, Discover (US dollars only), PayPal\*, SEPA, Diners Club, Japan Credit Bureau (JCB).
